comparison.objective: Touch one calibration contact with a mounted tool tip in four distinct orientations; candidate uses an extraction tool to remove a terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests repeated submillimeter tip placement, orientation diversity, and one-second stillness. Candidate tests two-blade insertion around a contact, force-controlled tang depression, and coordinated extraction.
comparison.success_condition: PR awards four valid contact poses with force/position/angle/stillness and mount-integrity limits. Candidate requires actual terminal withdrawal, neighbor retention, intact parts, and 3 s persistence.
comparison.reason: Both test precision tool alignment, but static calibration contacts do not test constrained latch release, maintained engagement, or bimanual removal.
